CNR4 · SW boom · iWS logger · UTC · in iws.csv
CNR1 body T biased until 28 Sep 13:00–13:30 LT.
• "12/13 cm" read as T/RH shield height above the boom;
sensing element height inside it unknown. T1: not noted.
• Sonic + Tc 79 cm below the 4 m boom; photo scaling gives
0.8–1.0 m. Tc assumed at the sonic's height.
• Fast vane, vertical propeller, Tc2 ≈ 3 m beside the sonic
• iWS and CNR4 not on the installation photos;
iWS height 3.62–3.80 m from its own SSH; CNR4 "about 4 m".
• Shields differ: white plate shields at 0.5–2 m, cylindrical
shields at 4 m and the top. Ventilation per level: ask Paul.
• 4 m level is crowded (two vanes, CNR1, extra diagonal
booms); which vane is U2 is not certain.
• "*" at the mast top read as U1 (729 cm); photo shows a vane.
• Compass directions of the profile booms not recorded.
• Nominal "8 m" level is ≈ 7.0–7.3 m, "4 m" ≈ 3.8–4.1 m,
• Wind spacings match the sketch's 68/93/193 cm within 1 cm.
